title: Toxic chemicals in fentanyl revealed by speedy technique
excerpt: Chemical fingerprinting charts the rises and declines of specific adulterants in illicit supplies of the drug.
content_html:
• RESEARCH HIGHLIGHT
  • 19 October 2026

Chemical fingerprinting charts the rises and declines of specific adulterants in illicit supplies of the drug.

Illegally manufactured versions of the painkiller fentanyl are being cut with an increasing range of potentially dangerous substances1. That’s according to a US rapid-analysis programme aimed at spotting changes in the make-up of fentanyl sold as a street drug.
